import copy
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import app

class Hidden(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_values_and_order(self):
        rows = [{"tenant":"z", "value":None}, {"tenant":" a ","value":4}, {"tenant":"b"}]
        original = copy.deepcopy(rows)
        result = app.migrate(rows)
        self.assertEqual(result,[{"tenant_key":"z","value":None},{"tenant_key":" a ","value":4},{"tenant_key":"b","value":None}])
        self.assertEqual(rows,original)
        self.assertIsNot(result,rows)
        self.assertTrue(all(a is not b for a,b in zip(result,rows)))
    def test_invalid(self):
        for row in [{}, {"tenant":""}, {"tenant":3}, None, ["x"]]:
            with self.subTest(row=row):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError): app.migrate([row])
    def test_empty_is_fresh(self):
        rows=[]
        self.assertIsNot(app.migrate(rows),rows)
    def test_protected(self):
        self.assertEqual(Path("protected_bridge.py").read_bytes(),b"COMPATIBILITY_VERSION = 7\n")
    def test_new_stage_values_order_and_preservation(self):
        batches = [[{"tenant":"z","value":None}], [], [{"tenant":" a ","value":4},{"tenant":"b"}]]
        original = copy.deepcopy(batches)
        result = app.migrate_many(batches)
        self.assertEqual(result,[{"tenant_key":"z","value":None},{"tenant_key":" a ","value":4},{"tenant_key":"b","value":None}])
        self.assertEqual(batches,original)
        self.assertIsNot(result,batches)
        self.assertTrue(all(all(item is not old for batch in batches for old in batch) for item in result))
    def test_new_stage_invalid_row(self):
        for row in [{}, {"tenant":""}, {"tenant":3}, None, ["x"]]:
            with self.subTest(row=row):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError): app.migrate_many([[{"tenant":"valid"}],[row]])
    def test_new_stage_empty_is_fresh(self):
        batches=[]
        self.assertIsNot(app.migrate_many(batches),batches)
        self.assertEqual(app.migrate_many([[],[]]),[])
